title: Features Schema
description: Provider-scoped service feature catalog. Identity is `id`. `name` is the operator’s original name; `label` is English. `kind` is cross-provider grouping only. `services[].features` references feature `id`.

id.description: Concrete provider-scoped feature id; referenced from services.json feature lists within the same provider

kind.description: Cross-provider semantic grouping (e.g. tracking). Not unique. Not a graph key.

name.description: Native-market display name (operator primary language, e.g. DE/FR)

label.description: English human-readable label for unified tooling and docs

requires.description: Optional extra inputs this feature always needs. Omit when none.
